content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: (a) M.Sc. in Botany/Life Science/Bioscience (Botany)/Marine Biology/Biotechnology/Microbiology or any allied biological sciences with a minimum of 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale. (b) Candidate qualified CSIR-UGC-NET/CSIR-UGC-NET (Category-III) or GATE. Desirable: Experience in the field of Cyanobacteria/Algae/Seaweeds Other conditions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Desirable: Post 1: Experience in the field of Cyanobacteria/Algae/Seaweeds Post 2: Experience in the field of Isopods/Amphipods, etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary basis Tenure initially for 1 year, extendable up to 5 years based on performance Under the OMBRIC research project funded by the Science and Technology Department, Govt. of Odisha

content_sections.heading: How Will BU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Verification of original documents Walk-in interview Original documents are verified before the interview Candidates with CSIR-UGC-NET/GATE are selected for JRF; candidates without it for Project Associate-I

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form (Annexure-I) One set of self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience and publications Valid ID proof Certificates, testimonials and other relevant documents (self-attested copies) Original documents for verification Passport-sized colour photos (02 nos)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form given as Annexure-I of the notice. Bring one set of self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience, publications, valid ID proof and other relevant documents. Bring original documents for verification and two passport-sized colour photos. Report at the P. G. Department of Botany, Berhampur University on 1 December 2026 at 10.00 AM.
